groups.label: One unit in your army with the Character special rule in your army may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.
groups.printed: One unit in your army with the Character special rule in your army may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.

choices.name: Alien Cunning
choices.text: If your army includes a model with this warlord trait, you can select up to 2 friendly Tyranid units in your army before deployment. They gain the Scout Special rule.

choices.name: Heightened Senses
choices.text: A model with this Warlord trait can always set to Overwatch, even if it makes shooting attacks in the shooting phase. In addition, the unit gains the Night Vision special rule.

choices.name: Synaptic Linchpin
choices.text: Extend the range of the Synapse rule a model with this Warlord Trait by +6". If they do not have the Synapse rule, they gain the Synapse special rule.

groups.label: Tyranid units with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase Psychic Powers from the following Discipline:
groups.printed: Tyranid units with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase Psychic Powers from the following Discipline:

choices.name: Catalyst
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 24" of the Psyker, it gains the Feel No Pain (5+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Dominion
choices.text: When this power is cast, All Tyranids on the battlefield count as being in Synapse for the purposes of the Synapse special rule until the Start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Onslaught
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 12" of the Psyker. The target unit may Advance in the Movement Phase and Shoot its weapons in the Shooting Phase with -1 to hit rolls.

choices.name: Paroxysm
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. That unit halves its Initiative (I) Characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Psychic Scream
choices.text: When this power is cast, each enemy units within 12" of the Psyker take D6 Strength User, AP 5 Pinning automatic hits.

choices.name: The Horror
choices.text: When this power is cast, select a single enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. That unit immediately makes a Pinning Test with -2 to its Leadership (LD) characteristic.

army_settings.name: Adaptive Physiology
army_settings.printed: During army building when mustering your force, you may pick 1 of the below Adaptations. All units with the Adaptive Physiology Special rule gain the benefit of that Adaptation for the rest of the game:

options.name: Adrenal Glands
options.text: A unit with this Adaptation gains the Sprint (1) special rule. Units that already have the Sprint (x) special rule increase the value of (x) by 1.

options.name: Toxin Sacs
options.text: All units with this Adaptation gain the Poison (4+) special rule on all weapons they are equipped with. If the unit already has the Poison (x) special rule this is increased by 1 to a max of Poison (3+).

options.name: Caustic Blood
options.text: When a unit with this adaptation is slain and the last model in the unit is removed from play, before that model is removed, all enemy units within 6" take D3+(x) automatic hits where (x) is the models Wounds (W) characteristic. The Strength of the hit is equal to the removed units Toughness (T) characteristic. The AP is resolved at AP5.
